parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel of the table made of wood, forming one of the supporting sides.
parts.Functional_description: Provides vertical structural support and stability to the tabletop and other components.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel located near the drawer section, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: Supports the drawer and shelf structure, maintaining rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel
parts.Basic_description: A vertical side panel on the opposite end of the table, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: Provides balance and structural integrity to the table frame.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf panel made of wood, located below the drawer.
parts.Functional_description: Used for storing or placing items such as books or accessories.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A back panel made of wood, connecting the vertical sides and providing rear support.
parts.Functional_description: Adds rigidity and prevents lateral movement of the table structure.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located under the tabletop, used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: Provides enclosed storage space for small items such as stationery.
parts.Movement_description: Slides in and out along rails for access.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: The main flat surface of the table made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: Serves as the primary working or placing surface for objects.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place; does not move during normal use.
